mechanicalMeaning: Reusable OpenRewrite/Maven recipe is the source-changing work product; target-file edits are never the primary work unit.
Discover and inventory source atoms, contracts, hashes, APIs and donor evidence before selecting or authoring a recipe.
Candidate analysis/transforms operate on bounded semantic atoms inside the sealed contract boundary.
Public/declared behavior and interface contracts remain unchanged unless an explicit migration is admitted.
LLM output is candidate evidence only and owns no canonical mutation or promotion authority.
Any LLM-assisted source change resolves to a Maven/OpenRewrite recipe-crate work order.
The Maven/OpenRewrite LLM lane fails closed unless one exact canonical task-crate document and its semantic SHA-256 root are supplied and verified before recipe planning.
Independent file-local analysis and candidate transforms may parallelize; canonical promotion is serial and proof-gated.
A source file may be repeatedly atomized and patternized without a policy iteration limit while its declared contract, interface and externally observable behavior remain unchanged and proof-gated.
Every refactoring recipe declares the smallest semantic authority in the strict FILE then VISIBILITY then PACKAGE then MODULE then MULTI_MODULE then LIBRARY lattice.
Repository size never widens recipe authority; scope promotes only when the proposed change actually crosses the next visibility, package, module, reactor or library contract boundary.
A source-changing OpenRewrite recipe or recipe DAG must pass bounded JUnit behavior, negative, drift and fixed-point tests before repository-wide application or CI fan-out.

Java 21 CI may horizontally fan out file-local candidate execution only after the exact ordered recipe DAG is Java-21 compiled, test-proven and content-addressable; CI produces proof, not autonomous promotion.

Small OpenRewrite/Maven recipe atoms resolve dependency ids once into immutable content-addressed RecipeStep roots; backend-specific schedulers may project that graph but may not rebuild or reinterpret topology.
Camel execution routes, Airflow scheduling source and Drools/KIE admission facts for one work order must bind the same canonical RecipeDag root and exact Maven execution-binding roots.
Camel, Airflow and Drools/KIE remain execution, scheduling and admission backends only; none grants semantic equivalence, direct source authority or canonical promotion.
When a reusable function, lambda or functional atom already expresses the operation, M3 reuses that callable as the executable leaf; a new wrapper/class is not authored merely for DAG participation.

Recipe/DAG metadata owns identity, ordering, dependency, scope, pattern/IOP roles, documentation and proof gates; Camel/Airflow/Drools projections reference the same callable/recipe leaf and never duplicate its implementation.
Backports and mechanical JDK refactors preserve existing upstream JDK identifiers verbatim unless an explicit compatibility migration separately authorizes a rename.
A genuinely new non-JDK capability introduced into a JDK-facing surface uses a compact coined term or stable acronym rather than a long descriptive identifier.

The full semantic expansion of a compact JDK-facing M3 name is retained in Javadoc, pattern/IOP roles, recipe metadata and architecture documentation instead of inflating the public/internal identifier.

Javadoc and other derivable semantic documentation are generated or repaired by source-bound recipes and must preserve code tokens/behavior unless an explicit documentation contract permits otherwise.
Donor repository revision, provenance and license are recorded before code-reuse review; study-only evidence has no code-copy authority.

hsoliwal/com.synexia is the canonical donor inventory, comparison, atomization, patternization, recipe mastery, provenance and convergence workspace; raw donor/workbench state is not treated as polished target-product code.

A task-bound public target repository receives only content-addressed recipe outputs and evidence that have passed the declared contract, JUnit, compiler/runtime/JNI/benchmark/fixed-point gates applicable to that target; donor bodies, unresolved experiments and unproven workspace state do not flow directly into targets.

Each public target repository owns its product naming, licenses, compatibility policy, build/test/runtime oracle and final serial promotion; Synexia supplies donor convergence and portable recipe/evidence handoffs but never grants target promotion authority.

Balanced challenge/problem evidence is joined to exact pinned repository revision and license evidence before any donor source can enter a reuse review; unpinned or unknown-license rows remain evidence-only.
Public specifications, documentation, screens and protocol evidence define compatibility contracts only; they never authorize copying proprietary implementation code or assets.
Unknown-license, proprietary, rejected or otherwise inadmissible implementation sources cannot enter donor adaptation, target mutation or promotion lanes.
LeetCode/HackerRank/GeeksforGeeks category search uses the precomputed index to nominate pinned donor repositories before serial per-file/atom review.
Cross-site challenge evidence is balanced across available LeetCode/HackerRank/GeeksforGeeks sources before bounded ranking; one site cannot silently dominate when reviewed alternatives exist.
Repeated file-local demand for the same capability is collapsed into one reusable recipe-development work unit rather than repeated target-file edits.
Public API, declared interfaces and externally observable behavior are immutable unless an explicit migration contract unlocks them.

M3String views and segmented text preserve the existing canonical MIndex parent/content identity plus UTF-16 ranges and segment metadata until an explicit materialization boundary; structural views do not create a second intern pool or silently flatten payloads.

Whole-spelling admission and contiguous java.lang.String creation are explicit M3Text.materialize or M3JdkStringBridge boundaries; generic structural composition/view operations do not own or hide those copies.

The published M3String subSequence, substring and concat compatibility contracts remain materializing/canonicalizing as introduced; new viewUtf16, viewCodePointSafe and compose APIs add structural behavior without silently changing existing descriptors or semantics.
M3String metadata, precompute images, profiles and repeated-substring indexes delegate to the existing MIndex owners/cache/indexes; M3 must not create a parallel precompute/search engine or cache.

M3Text belongs to the legacy/runtime M3 owner and cannot enter MIndexCanonicalStorageGate directly; the strict canonical IndexString owner transition must remain explicit and owner-local IDs are never treated as portable identity.

Transition from M3Text to a canonical IndexString resolver performs one explicit final JDK UTF-16 materialization, verifies content/hash parity, records a deterministic admission receipt and must not first admit a whole spelling into the legacy runtime pool.

Native-required M3 UTF-16 search may execute only over values admitted to the same canonical IndexString resolver with direct read-only shared-storage descriptors; VM-local overlays, foreign owners and hidden transport copies have no native-required authority.

Canonical M3 search reuses MIndexSegmentUtf16Search so JNI unavailability, optional-symbol absence or nondirect canonical overlay storage preserves the exact Java UTF-16 fallback contract instead of changing search semantics.

Building or querying M3SubstringIndex preserves Java UTF-16 coordinates and cannot admit matched substrings into the canonical String pool; query results are offsets/fingerprints until a caller explicitly materializes text.

M3TextView, M3CompositeString and M3CompositeView retain structural parent/range identity and have no implicit canonical-string precompute/index path; callers cross M3Text.materialize() explicitly before M3String precompute/search.
Private implementation atoms may be decomposed or refined without a policy iteration limit while public contract and external behavior remain sealed and every candidate stays proof-gated.
A private atom replacement is not promotable until recipe ownership, differential behavior proof, compiler/tests and JNI parity when required all pass.
Verified leaf atoms recompress deterministically through FILE then PACKAGE then MODULE then PROJECT proof scopes before canonical promotion.

Resolved pinned Java donor platform/repository/commit/path identities and the JavaProblemCorpus index root are content-addressed into the shape plan and recipe work order; donor evidence has no direct mutation authority.

Each method-level algorithm atom review reuses the same precomputed JavaProblemCorpus resolved evidence selection and corpus root as file-level planning; atom donor evidence is read-only and grants no copy or promotion authority.

Every recipe work order carrying pinned donor Java files also carries a content-addressed SerialProblemReview report root and donor-review receipt root binding the exact files, reviewed source identities and review counts; no receipt grants copy, execution, replacement or promotion authority.

After Git-verified donor materialization, the exact non-contiguous donor files named by a recipe work order are reviewed through M3PinnedDonorSourceReview; a domain-separated handoff receipt binds the work-order root, donor file-review root, full/subset materialization roots and atom-review batch root without granting source-copy, execution, replacement or promotion authority.

After exact Git-materialized donor bodies complete work-order-bound atom review, the next LLM source-changing work unit is the generic Maven/OpenRewrite recipe crate; donor/atom evidence cannot authorize direct target-file mutation.

Every target path in an admitted recipe crate is reviewed exactly once in deterministic serial path order through the canonical one-file serial atom reviewer before downstream verification; no partial target subset can stand in for full crate coverage.
After diff review, formatting/lint/static-analysis gates execute before compilation and tests.
Repeatable JDT/IDE transformations are captured as reusable recipes.
Problem/donor catalogues select or open recipe work; catalogue matches never directly replace source.
Apply mechanical passes until the second pass is unchanged before promotion.
Diff, lint/static analysis, compile, tests, runtime where required, contract proof, Java oracle, JNI parity where declared and benchmark gates precede fixed-point proof and promotion.

Before source-changing work, the complete applicable hierarchy is inventoried deterministically from PROJECT to MODULE to PACKAGE to FILE to METHOD/ATOM; independent files may fan out, but work inside one file remains serial and contract-locked.
For every detected algorithm/problem shape, indexed challenge taxonomy evidence is reviewed in deterministic LeetCode then HackerRank then GeeksforGeeks order before donor adaptation or synthesis.

After challenge taxonomy/category review and before recipe work-order development, the canonical donor selector records one deterministic best admissible evidence choice per mechanical shape; contest repositories remain taxonomy/reference evidence, unresolved shapes stay explicit, and selection grants no source-copy, replacement or promotion authority.

The canonical full algorithm review composes the file-local problem planner and materializes one deduplicated candidate-only recipe work order per capability before any source-changing lane is admitted.

JNI hot-path review is composed only after Java-oracle/category/donor/problem work-order planning; native evidence cannot bypass the recipe work order, Java oracle, parity, fallback or benchmark gates.
LeetCode, HackerRank and GeeksforGeeks problem/editorial/solution bodies are reference-only evidence and never grant source-copy, substitution, execution or promotion authority.
Every target path named by an admitted recipe crate is reviewed exactly once in deterministic serial path order before downstream verification; partial, duplicate or extra target work fails closed.
Java remains the semantic oracle; JNI/C/C++/GPU/native acceleration is admitted only after the Java result and contract are established.
Any native/JNI acceleration requires exact Java parity plus lifecycle/resource-safety and explicit fallback behavior before it can contribute to promotion evidence.

C/C++/JNI whole-source atom/pattern coverage reuses the canonical coverage algebra only through an explicit trusted NativeFunctionAtoms-backed adapter; native parsing/search evidence never substitutes for compile/test, ABI or Java/JNI parity proof.
A native/performance optimization claim requires a benchmark that includes setup/admission cost and compares against the Java baseline; throughput claims cannot rely on kernel-only timing.

Every reviewed LeetCode/HackerRank/GeeksForGeeks logical problem records ordered pass states, exact pinned donor provenance/license evidence, local Java reuse, native lane and one deterministic next action before recipe/native/promotion work; the ledger grants no source-copy, execution, replacement or promotion authority.

Every declared ProblemCategory is reviewed against LeetCode, HackerRank and GeeksForGeeks metadata and records exactly one deterministic READY, PARTIAL or NO_EVIDENCE next action before donor, recipe or JNI work; the action ledger grants no source-copy, replacement or promotion authority.

Every classified algorithm atom binds the exact deterministic C/C++/GPU donor set selected by NativeMechanicsDonorCatalog before serial review; donor comparison never grants copy or execution authority.
Any JNI/native candidate must carry the canonical serial native-donor comparison receipt before native recipe-crate admission, build, linkage, parity and fallback gates.

Every inventoried API operation is mechanically mapped to observed data representation, index/precompute evidence and implementation strategy before recipe work is opened; the mapping is evidence only and grants no semantic promotion authority.
Every unresolved API/data/precompute capability is converted into the canonical repository recipe work-order and exact capability-tag coverage path before authoring or reuse is selected.
Repository recipe scaffolding consumes only AUTHOR_RECIPE coverage rows; exact registered reuse is reused and ambiguous exact matches remain held rather than generating duplicate recipes.

Each AUTHOR_RECIPE repository work order is content-addressed into one candidate-only M3LlmTaskRecipeCrate before any implementation recipe is edited; stale author work fails if the catalogue now resolves the capability.

Each API AUTHOR_RECIPE LLM crate binds the existing API behavior/challenge/donor review plan before implementation work; review evidence grants no mutation, donor-copy, native-execution or promotion authority.
API implementation review fails closed unless the exact task-crate root and its task-bound review-plan root agree on capability and crate identity before the read-only review recipes run.

Recipe-first bootstrap must use the structured parser/recipe lane matching the target source kind; Java cannot silently fall back to Python/plain-text mutation and ambiguous AUTO source patterns fail closed.
Partial-AST candidate work is admitted only inside a sealed leaf scope whose source/contract custody is explicit; partial trees do not grant parent or external contract authority.
Any partial-AST candidate whose exact source/preimage identity is stale is rejected before replacement or recomposition evidence can advance.
Parent fan-in from independently reviewed partial-AST leaves is a separate serial admission/proof step; leaf success cannot implicitly authorize parent replacement.
Heap-resident full/partial ASTs and all eviction-policy metadata are disposable acceleration state; source plus verified SQLite/MIndex persistence remain semantic replay authority.
Partial-AST ghost history may retain only exact versioned residency keys and eviction cause, never AST/resolver/parser/source payloads, and can never satisfy semantic lookup or authorize mutation.
Elevated/critical heap pressure may shrink or clear partial-AST residents and ghost metadata down to zero without changing semantic identity, caller-held immutable values or persistent replay state.
Eviction and re-reference feedback may tune only disposable residency policy; it cannot change ContractEnvelope, MIndex semantic hashes, source mutation authority or promotion evidence.
For LLM-assisted source-changing tasks the model edits or improves the bounded Maven/OpenRewrite recipe crate and fixtures, not each matched target file directly.
Algorithm-atom manifests retain the exact native-donor catalogue/review roots used to nominate JNI/C/C++/GPU mechanics so later native work is traceable to read-only review evidence.
The deterministic serial structure of an algorithm-atom plan is validated before a manifest is emitted; malformed or reordered atom plans fail closed before recipe/native handoff.

After serial canonical promotion, reread every expected target path from the canonical branch/tree and require exact reviewed Git blob identity; merge/PR state or ancestry alone is provenance and cannot close the task.
Logical String concatenation/compose/repeat retains canonical token/segment references or descriptor DAGs; it does not manufacture a Java array spanning unrelated payload allocations.

char[]/byte[]/String or one-contiguous-buffer contracts are explicit materialization boundaries; JNI/native hot paths prefer immutable direct scatter/gather segments and may allocate descriptor metadata but not joined payloads.

Persistent logical String composition records content-addressed immutable parent payload identities plus primitive ranges; process-local pool/symbol/region IDs and machine pointers are never durable identities.

Filesystem precompute retains immutable device-neutral bytes, offsets, postings, bitmaps, automata and segment geometry; device buffers, streams, kernels, launch state and transfer scratch remain runtime-only.
Refactoring authority grows only FILE -> VISIBILITY -> PACKAGE -> MODULE -> MULTI_MODULE -> LIBRARY_API; a narrower recipe cannot acquire broader mutation authority for convenience.
A FILE-scoped recipe is independently executable against one sealed target and may not create, delete, rename or mutate another file; broader relationships require explicit scope promotion.
Every exact/hash-pinned recipe target is bound to its reviewed verbatim source preimage SHA-256 (or explicit ABSENT additive state); source drift blocks replay rather than inviting inference.
Each M3 scope pass reaches its explicit fixed point/evidence stop condition before authority may promote to the next broader scope.
Reusable OpenRewrite recipes require JUnit proof of admission, transformation/refusal behavior, idempotence/fixed point and scope fences before promotion.

Recipe modules target at least 99% executable line and branch coverage while declared atom behaviors, pattern/IOP roles and public contracts require explicit JUnit proof; superficial line execution is not sufficient.

Every FILE frontier executes inventory then reviewed atomization recipes then pattern/IOP recipes then derivable documentation recipes and must reach an unchanged second-pass fixed point before visibility/package/module authority may advance.

MIndex implementation and coordinates remain valid while Apache-2.0 M3Index compatibility artifacts are introduced additively; Maven coordinates may migrate by tested OpenRewrite recipe before Java type ownership moves, and no original implementation is removed until contract/JUnit/fixed-point proof closes.

Every classified AlgorithmShape resolves through one content-addressed precomputed join of normalized category, platform taxonomy/capability evidence and optimization/native-lane plan before donor selection, recipe work or JNI review; the joined plan is evidence-only and grants no source-copy, replacement, execution or promotion authority.

A JNI/native candidate must bind content-addressed recipe-work-order, native-donor-review, Java-oracle, differential-corpus, lifecycle/fallback and setup-inclusive-benchmark roots before admission; the evidence is candidate-only and grants no source-mutation, native-execution or promotion authority.

Structural, control-flow, contract and effect facts come from the lossless/attributed Java tree first; regex may run only over a length-preserving string/comment/text-block masked view as bounded nomination evidence.
A regex cue may nominate a pattern or residue row but can never certify semantic equivalence, authorize a source mutation, or promote a candidate.
Independent immutable signal recognizers may fan out in parallel; rows are canonicalized and sorted before one content-addressed DAG/repository root is reduced deterministically.

The atomize/patternize signal chain must prove masking, hostile mixed Java shapes, idempotent repeated execution, input-order independence and explicit failure when the configured pass budget cannot reach the fixed point.
Canonical machine identity and semantic structure are recorded before generated names, documentation or other human projections; a projection cannot redefine canonical identity.
Inventory and atom boundaries are established before pattern/IOP roles are assigned, and those reviewed roles precede any source-changing implementation recipe.
A code signal is normalized into a problem/algorithm shape and then a candidate-only recipe work order; signal detection itself never mutates source.
Compatible public FOSS donors are reviewed for provenance, license and mechanics before reimplementation; review alone grants no source-copy authority.
Editing an implementation recipe requires an exact source-bound API/behavior review receipt tied to the admitted task and recipe crate.
An external donor is Mavenized into a bounded review workspace and inventoried, atomized and patternized before any absorption candidate is admitted.
External-donor inventory carries structure, semantic, JNI/native and pattern evidence together so later review cannot silently drop an evidence dimension.
An external-donor absorption plan is candidate evidence only and grants no source-copy, mutation, replacement or promotion authority.
A capability implementation recipe is authored only after the exact external-donor absorption disposition and plan have been recorded.
Mechanical donor-shape review completes before the corresponding reusable Maven/OpenRewrite recipe crate is admitted.
The exact content-addressed mechanical donor-review root is retained in the recipe crate so donor custody is replayable.
A catalogued algorithm atom retains its exact mechanical donor-review binding before source-changing or native work.
The mechanical donor binding is validated before a bound recipe may execute; execution cannot create missing donor custody retroactively.
Source-bound review of a catalogued algorithm atom fails closed unless its exact mechanical donor binding is present.
Executed-contract evidence retains the mechanical donor binding used at admission so execution cannot sever provenance.
Mechanical donor custody roots survive serial promotion and canonical-tree readback without granting additional mutation, copy or promotion authority.
Canonical collection storage does not retain one Entry, node, bucket or cell object per element; compatibility objects are boundary projections only.
JDK Map.Entry compatibility views are fresh, unpooled and unretained projections rather than canonical collection storage.
Collection construction stores per-element structural metadata in a primitive aspect word rather than a retained object graph.
Physical collection indexing and lookup layout are provider-owned implementation strategy, not part of the public semantic contract.
Collection pressure and residency management reuse the existing MIndex swap plane instead of creating a parallel eviction or paging engine.
Durable SQLite cold-page identity remains stable when heap residency is reduced to zero and is the replay anchor for later demand.
Collection algorithm donor review reuses the canonical LeetCode, HackerRank and GeeksForGeeks category evidence path before pinned FOSS donor selection.
Hash structures are optional lookup indexes and are not the default canonical per-element storage representation.
A pressure-driven shrink must release actual backing residency or storage rather than only lowering logical counters.
After pressure subsides, collection residency is repopulated lazily on explicit demand rather than eagerly rebuilding all backing state.
LLM-assisted repository execution is admitted only when complete Git-tree inventory and exact recipe-capability coverage are both required and satisfied.
Recipe mastery is qualified on bounded generated multi-file in-memory Java projects rather than a single production example or LLM judgment.
Mastery retains bounded recipe subsets, repetitions and order permutations so ordering and idempotence defects become executable regression evidence.
Every admitted mastery stage recompiles the complete project and executes an independent frozen behavioral oracle before the next stage may run.
A mastery claim requires public/protected API stability, an unchanged complete round within budget and no repeated-state oscillation.
Compile, behavior, API, oracle, recipe, oscillation, budget and cross-program divergence are retained as typed regression residue and are never silently discarded.
LLM optimization proposals consume precomputed structural/control/effect/pattern/mastery signals as candidate evidence; static evidence precedes any recipe change.
Finite corpus convergence, compiler success and test success qualify a recipe candidate but never grant canonical promotion authority.

Reusable recipe mastery is admitted only when bounded in-memory ambiguous projects include code-like string/regex/text-block/comment decoys, every tested recipe order compiles and passes deterministic behavior probes, the canonical external contract root is unchanged, and a no-change fixed point is reached without oscillation.

Every LLM recipe crate carries a content-addressed bounded mastery plan; Java recipe work binds ambiguity fixtures, compiler, behavior oracle, external contract root, recipe/source order checks, oscillation detection and no-change fixed point before promotion, while non-Java source kinds retain explicit structured fixture mastery rather than borrowing a false Java oracle.

Within one bounded recipe-mastery search, exact sorted Java source path/content roots precompute immutable compiler, deterministic behavior, external-contract and static-signal evidence once and reuse it across recipe permutations; the cache is fixture-local/search-local, fail-closed, and grants no semantic, mutation, source-copy or promotion authority.

The develop branch is an append-only evidence chain and is never rebased; merged ancestry does not prove current-tree retention, so post-merge readback detects lost good code and recovery is an additive recipe-backed superset over the current tree.

An LLM source-changing task has no direct edit authority and cannot admit atom mutation until one class-backed recipe, one Maven proof POM, one content-addressed inventory root and the declared mechanical gates are bound into the task receipt.

Regex/String recipe mastery preserves the stable compatibility corpus, generated Java-project ambiguity fixtures and JDK truth matrix while adding a deterministic 100-by-100 mass signal/oracle matrix; the scopes complement rather than replace each other.

The 10,000-case regex/String mass matrix may precompute static lexical/encoding/syntax evidence and export OpenRewrite data tables but JDK regex execution remains semantic truth and the matrix grants no mutation, replacement or promotion authority.

JNI acceleration for the 10,000-case regex/String signal matrix reuses the canonical one-crossing native batch owner and must match the Java static-signal image/root exactly; JNI never becomes regex semantic authority.

One class-backed composite recipe serially binds LeetCode/HackerRank/GeeksforGeeks evidence, pass-ledger review, 10k signal/oracle evidence, native candidate signals, convergence replay and compiler/JUnit/JNI proof without acquiring promotion authority.
All MIndex precompute tables, caches, images, search facts, metadata lanes and prepared plans are internal implementation machinery; they are not a user-facing compatibility surface.
MIndexString and other public value APIs expose semantic operations/results, never ownership, retention, invalidation, cache-budget or preparation lifecycle of precompute machinery.
Internal precompute is keyed by canonical owner/identity plus exact range/composition coordinates; equal numeric IDs from different owners never alias.
Derived facts may accelerate operations but never become a second spelling store or canonical payload and never change String/MIndex semantics when absent.
JNI/native byte, char, UTF-8 and UTF-16 arrays/buffers are derived shadows materialized from canonical MIndex coordinates; shadows are never retained as canonical MIndexString storage.

Synexia is the donor/reference world; a target such as M3JDK may use different M3 names, but must preserve canonical owner+coordinate structure, internal-precompute semantics and explicit materialization boundaries rather than copy donor identifiers blindly.
